The documents don't say which race was Felipe Massa's first Grand Prix win. The only Massa win listed is the 2007 Spanish Grand Prix (document 4), which was not his first. From my own knowledge, not the documents, his first win was the 2006 Turkish Grand Prix. That makes the season 2006.

Document 7 covers the 2006 season, but it only shows the Spanish Grand Prix result, not the constructors' standings. From memory, Renault won the 2006 constructors' championship, but the documents don't confirm this.

ANSWER: Renault
